body:
Lesson (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-07 06:17Z). After restart 1, DL560 messages showed "durableButNotWoken" and the DL560 sessions were listed with status null. I told Greg DL560 was unreachable (#711) and asked him to check it. In fact the host was up from 06:03:53Z, and the messages were just delivered late. My withdrawal (#714) reached him too late, and he restarted DL560 a second time. That probably cut off session-4's E3(b) build.

RULE: "durableButNotWoken" or a null session status right after a restart is NOT evidence that a host is down. Before escalating a host problem to Greg, wait for at least one read-only check from a session on that host, or a confirmed lack of response after a reasonable delay (10 min or more). State any inference as unconfirmed. Never ask Greg to act on a host based on wake status alone.
